title: AI formative-assessment scoping review
goal: A scoping-review reader can trace evidence selection from 2,100 records to 72 sources.

rubric.must: The four-row PRISMA flow is visibly present using scoping-review vocabulary.
The 2,100 identified, 420 duplicates removed, and 1,680 screened counts visibly reconcile.
Visible exclusion boxes account for screening and full-text exclusions.
The final box visibly reports 72 sources of evidence/reports.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 satisfies all five criteria, while Image 2 fails the required counts despite having a clear flow.
